mapper.select: SELECT sys09_code AS code , sys09_name AS name , sys09_seq::text AS seq FROM sys09_code c , sys08_code_kind k WHERE sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id AND ( ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) OR ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') != 'true' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} ) ) AND sys08_kind_cd = 'BizCardUseItemCode' AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= f_trunc(#{applyDate}) ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'false' ) ) AND sys09_apply_date = (SELECT max(x.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code x WHERE x.sys09_code_kind_id = c.sys09_code_kind_id AND x.sys09_company_id = c.sys09_company_id AND x.sys09_code = c.sys09_code AND x.sys09_apply_date <= f_trunc(#{applyDate})) ORDER BY sys09_seq
